description: DRAFT (not registered). ALTERNATIVE (fixed 4-byte patches; SQ374 found fixed patches far too costly at this scale): Control A'': unshared 2-layer decoder with the r2_shared arm's unique decoder params (two different lswa+SwiGLU blocks, SwiGLU hidden 74 instead of 320); same passes, depth and init scale, fewer decoder FLOPs.

computed.note: computed by gogeta.c2f (FusionDance's counting rule: 2 x params per application + attention/GDN terms, training = 3 x forward); per byte; NOT measured

notes: Global = a3mx.json's structure with the width scaled to d_model 256 (head_dim 64, mlp_hidden 704, moe_hidden 352) so train FLOPs/byte ~ E1/3.735 (a3mx's own d_model 384 costs 42.62M/byte in the global model alone at P = 4, 1.75 x that target). window = 256 PATCHES. code-py-v1-bytes (no v2 byte dataset). 74.7M bytes = 20M token-equivalents; warmup 280 steps = a3mx's warmup in token-equivalents; --max-tokens counts BYTES here. Param-matched control: SwiGLU hidden 74 (vs 320).
